item.title: Floyd Mayweather’s WBC Champion Emeritus Status Explained
item.description: As World Boxing News recently reported, Floyd Mayweather’s WBC Champion Emeritus designation remains active within the organization’s regulatory framework. This stipulation, handed down upon his retirement in 2015, can still play a part in his September 19 rematch with Manny Pacquiao as the clash moves forward as a professional bout. item.title: Manny Pacquiao’s Son Eman Bacosa Scores Five Knockdowns in Bohol
item.description: Eman Bacosa did not need the scorecards in Bohol, as five knockdowns rendered them unnecessary.
